prompt: What's looking interesting in the market today? I have $50k to deploy.

assertions.text: Report contains real-time price data (not from training data)
Identifies 3+ specific stock opportunities with tickers
Provides dollar allocation for the $50k budget
Includes risk assessment for each opportunity
Includes macro context for current market conditions
Each opportunity has a clear thesis (not just 'looks good')
Includes hidden opportunities / bonus picks section
